_comment: The availability plan, keyed by area (authoring plan Step 2, revised 2026-09-21 for Ian's capture rules): per live land table the lines at home there (the one table designed for the line), the cameos (every other appearance, day and night pairs included), and the tails (the real 4% and 1% slots). A gate-tier starter may appear as a cameo or a tail, never as a home. `corridor_splits` names the splits whose tables carry only starter-adjacent lines, scripted lines and tails. `water` maps water lines to the surf/rod tables that are their homes; `honey`, `pool` and `proposals` are the non-land sources. Splits live in the sidecar.

_comment: Ian, 2026-09-21: vanilla's three pre-League legendaries (Uxie, Azelf, the
roaming Mesprit) already felt like a lot, and twenty new ones as statics is
not feasible, so the two lake caverns and the roamer slot each draw one at
random. Since 2026-09-26 (Ian) each draws from its own third, so no two can
be the same: `acuity` for Uxie's cavern, `valor` for Azelf's, `roamer` for
Mesprit's roamer. The thirds were dealt strongest first by the line ratings
(values.json), each keeping its own lake guardian. The scripting is outside
this track (decision 8); a candidate counts as sourced on paper, and R12
reports these lines until the scripts exist.
The two cavern draws are turned off for now (Ian, 2026-09-26); the roamer's third stands.
pool.roamer: Mesprit's roamer, released at Lake Verity

_comment: The honey trees (Ian, 2026-09-26): 21 trees from Route 205 onward, one table
per badge count (1 to 8) with its own levels, a common and an uncommon tier
of six slots each; the Munchlax trees and their rare tier are gone, and the
grass starters with them (their homes are Eterna Forest, Route 204 north and
Route 210 south). Listed here per tier across all eight tables; the tables
The two box legendaries, the only new statics, both post-League by Ian's
rule. Script work outside this track; counted as sourced on paper.
proposals.SPECIES_XERNEAS: static, post-League, Sendoff Spring's shrine (the life tree by the spring)
proposals.SPECIES_YVELTAL: static, post-League, Route 224's shrine stone, the mirror of Xerneas
